title: The Fourth, 2024
logline: White fireworks, the dock, a knee and a hand at the bottom edge. Seven weeks before the dock sequence. No second hand yet; the step beside the hand is bare wood, and the page draws the bare wood.

panels.composition: The dock at night under white fireworks from the shack steps: the family, the ramp, the pup barking at the sky, and at the bottom edge a knee in worn jeans with a hand on it, and beside the hand a stretch of bare step, drawn with care.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a dock at night under white fireworks seen from shack steps with a family and a plank ramp and a small three-legged dog barking at the sky, and at the bottom edge a man's knee in worn jeans with his hand on it beside a stretch of bare wooden step, no words
image.notes: The bare step beside the hand. Compare ro_2026-07-04.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The bare step beside the hand.
